title: Old Wanchai Market Building
geometryBasis: Open government plan data, five-meter bare-earth DTM and the precisely dated public-domain Qualla view of the southwest market corner. The tall redevelopment mass is included because it stands directly over the preserved market.
sectionBasis: Historic Building Appraisal 590 documents the two main market stories, thin typhoon canopies, piloti and white render with dark edging. The 2008 preservation scheme documents exactly which characteristic elements survived and specifies a pale-grey contemporary tower with rounded corners and horizontal ledges.
limitations: The preserved market corner, canopies, window ribbons and piers are scaled from the surveyed current plan and the 2007 Qualla frontage photograph. The photo predates adaptive reuse, so current entrance glazing and some small façade details are interpreted.
The attached tower uses Lands Department height and footprint dimensions with medium-fidelity façade bands. Detailed lift facilities, apartment interiors, retail fittings and signs are outside scope.
